package access_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"math"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"example.com/mutationfixture/contract"
	access "example.com/mutationfixture/providers/accounts.user/v1"
	"github.com/plystra/data/database"
)

type recorder struct {
	plan   database.Plan
	ctx    context.Context
	result database.Result
	err    error
	calls  int
}

func (r *recorder) Health(context.Context) error { return nil }
func (r *recorder) Exec(ctx context.Context, plan database.Plan) (database.Result, error) {
	r.ctx, r.plan = ctx, plan
	r.calls++
	return r.result, r.err
}

func values() []database.Value {
	// RETURNING order deliberately differs from the sorted result IDs.
	return []database.Value{
		database.Float64Argument(2.5), database.BytesArgument([]byte("optional")), database.BoolArgument(false), database.StringArgument(""), database.Int64Argument(0),
		database.Float64Argument(1.5), database.BytesArgument([]byte("token")), database.BoolArgument(true), database.StringArgument("text"), database.Int64Argument(7),
	}
}

func TestGeneratedMutationProviderContract(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	request := contract.Request{Key: 7, Text: "text", Active: true, Token: []byte("token"), Score: 1.5}
	backend := &recorder{}
	provider, err := access.New(backend)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var resource contract.Resource = provider
	for _, method := range []struct {
		name, operation string
		cardinality     database.Cardinality
		call            func() (any, error)
	}{
		{"InsertOne", "INSERT", database.CardinalityExactlyOne, func() (any, error) { return resource.InsertOne(ctx, request) }},
		{"InsertOptional", "INSERT", database.CardinalityZeroOrOne, func() (any, error) { return resource.InsertOptional(ctx, request) }},
		{"InsertMany", "INSERT", database.CardinalityMany, func() (any, error) { return resource.InsertMany(ctx, request) }},
		{"UpdateOne", "UPDATE", database.CardinalityExactlyOne, func() (any, error) { return resource.UpdateOne(ctx, request) }},
		{"UpdateOptional", "UPDATE", database.CardinalityZeroOrOne, func() (any, error) { return resource.UpdateOptional(ctx, request) }},
		{"UpdateMany", "UPDATE", database.CardinalityMany, func() (any, error) { return resource.UpdateMany(ctx, request) }},
		{"DeleteOne", "DELETE", database.CardinalityExactlyOne, func() (any, error) { return resource.DeleteOne(ctx, contract.Filter{Key: 7}) }},
		{"DeleteOptional", "DELETE", database.CardinalityZeroOrOne, func() (any, error) { return resource.DeleteOptional(ctx, contract.Filter{Key: 7}) }},
		{"DeleteMany", "DELETE", database.CardinalityMany, func() (any, error) { return resource.DeleteMany(ctx, contract.Filter{Key: 7}) }},
	} {
		t.Run(method.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			backend.err = nil
			backend.result = database.Result{Statements: []database.StatementResult{{Rows: [][]database.Value{values()}}}}
			output, err := method.call()
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			row := asRow(t, output)
			if row.Key != 7 || row.Text != "text" || !row.Active || row.Score != 1.5 || string(row.Token) != "token" || row.OptionalKey == nil || *row.OptionalKey != 0 || row.OptionalText == nil || *row.OptionalText != "" || row.OptionalActive == nil || *row.OptionalActive || row.OptionalToken == nil || string(*row.OptionalToken) != "optional" || row.OptionalScore == nil || *row.OptionalScore != 2.5 {
				t.Fatalf("wrong RETURNING field mapping: %#v", row)
			}
			if backend.ctx != ctx || backend.plan.Validate() != nil || len(backend.plan.Statements) != 1 {
				t.Fatal("lost context or invalid plan")
			}
			statement := backend.plan.Statements[0]
			args := []database.Argument{database.Int64Argument(7)}
			if method.operation != "DELETE" {
				args = []database.Argument{database.StringArgument("text"), database.BoolArgument(true), database.BytesArgument([]byte("token")), database.Float64Argument(1.5), database.Int64Argument(7)}
			}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(statement.Args, args) || statement.Cardinality != method.cardinality || !statement.ReturnsRows || statement.Affected != (database.AffectedRows{}) || len(statement.ResultColumns) != 10 || !statement.ResultColumns[0].Nullable || statement.ResultColumns[9].Kind != database.ValueInt64 || !strings.Contains(statement.SQL, method.operation+" ") || !strings.Contains(statement.SQL, "RETURNING") || !strings.Contains(statement.SQL, `"optional-score" AS "out-optional-score"`) {
				t.Fatalf("wrong mutation plan: %#v", statement)
			}
			if method.operation != "DELETE" {
				request.Token[0] = 'X'
				if string(statement.Args[2].Bytes) != "token" {
					t.Fatal("request bytes aliased")
				}
				request.Token[0] = 't'
			}
			backend.result.Statements[0].Rows[0][6].Bytes[0] = 'X'
			backend.result.Statements[0].Rows[0][1].Bytes[0] = 'X'
			if string(row.Token) != "token" || string(*row.OptionalToken) != "optional" {
				t.Fatal("RETURNING bytes aliased backend storage")
			}
			nulls := values()
			for index := range 5 {
				nulls[index] = database.NullArgument()
			}
			backend.result.Statements[0].Rows = [][]database.Value{nulls}
			output, err = method.call()
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			row = asRow(t, output)
			if row.OptionalKey != nil || row.OptionalText != nil || row.OptionalActive != nil || row.OptionalToken != nil || row.OptionalScore != nil {
				t.Fatal("SQL NULL became a non-null pointer")
			}
			backend.result.Statements[0].Rows = nil
			output, err = method.call()
			if method.cardinality == database.CardinalityExactlyOne {
				assertZeroError(t, output, err, database.ErrNotFound)
			} else if err != nil || (method.cardinality == database.CardinalityZeroOrOne && !reflect.ValueOf(output).IsNil()) || (method.cardinality == database.CardinalityMany && len(output.([]contract.Row)) != 0) {
				t.Fatal("empty RETURNING result changed", output, err)
			}
			backend.result.Statements[0].Rows = [][]database.Value{values(), values()}
			output, err = method.call()
			if method.cardinality == database.CardinalityMany {
				if err != nil || len(output.([]contract.Row)) != 2 {
					t.Fatal("many RETURNING rejected", err)
				}
				rows := output.([]contract.Row)
				*rows[0].OptionalKey = 99
				if *rows[1].OptionalKey != 0 {
					t.Fatal("nullable fields alias across rows")
				}
			} else {
				assertZeroError(t, output, err, database.ErrBackend)
			}
			malformed := []database.Result{{}, {Statements: []database.StatementResult{{}, {}}}, {Statements: []database.StatementResult{{Rows: [][]database.Value{values()}, AffectedRows: 1}}}, {Statements: []database.StatementResult{{Rows: [][]database.Value{{database.Int64Argument(1)}}}}}}
			for index := range 10 {
				bad := values()
				bad[index] = database.Argument{Kind: "unknown"}
				rows := [][]database.Value{bad}
				if method.cardinality == database.CardinalityMany {
					rows = append([][]database.Value{values()}, rows...)
				}
				malformed = append(malformed, database.Result{Statements: []database.StatementResult{{Rows: rows}}})
				if index >= 5 {
					nulls := append([]database.Value(nil), bad...)
					nulls[index] = database.NullArgument()
					rows = [][]database.Value{nulls}
					if method.cardinality == database.CardinalityMany {
						rows = append([][]database.Value{values()}, rows...)
					}
					malformed = append(malformed, database.Result{Statements: []database.StatementResult{{Rows: rows}}})
				}
			}
			for _, result := range malformed {
				backend.result = result
				output, err := method.call()
				assertZeroError(t, output, err, database.ErrBackend)
			}
			for _, cause := range []error{database.ErrConflict, database.ErrNotFound, database.ErrResultUnknown, context.Canceled, context.DeadlineExceeded} {
				backend.result = database.Result{Statements: []database.StatementResult{{Rows: [][]database.Value{values()}}}}
				backend.err = cause
				calls := backend.calls
				output, err := method.call()
				assertZeroError(t, output, err, cause)
				if err != cause || backend.calls != calls+1 {
					t.Fatal("backend error changed or mutation retried")
				}
			}
		})
	}
	for _, method := range []struct {
		name string
		call func() (uint64, error)
	}{
		{"InsertCount", func() (uint64, error) { return resource.InsertCount(ctx, request) }},
		{"UpdateCount", func() (uint64, error) { return resource.UpdateCount(ctx, request) }},
		{"DeleteCount", func() (uint64, error) { return resource.DeleteCount(ctx, contract.Filter{Key: 7}) }},
		{"Clear", func() (uint64, error) { return resource.Clear(ctx, contract.Empty{}) }},
	} {
		t.Run(method.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			backend.err = nil
			for _, count := range []uint64{0, 1, 2, math.MaxUint64} {
				backend.result = database.Result{Statements: []database.StatementResult{{AffectedRows: count}}}
				got, err := method.call()
				if err != nil || got != count || backend.ctx != ctx || backend.plan.Validate() != nil || len(backend.plan.Statements) != 1 {
					t.Fatal("affected count lost", got, err)
				}
				statement := backend.plan.Statements[0]
				if statement.ReturnsRows || statement.Cardinality != database.CardinalityNone || statement.Affected != database.AtLeastAffectedRows(0) || len(statement.ResultColumns) != 0 || strings.Contains(statement.SQL, "RETURNING") {
					t.Fatal("count method added a restrictive assertion or row contract")
				}
				wantArgs := []database.Argument{database.Int64Argument(7)}
				switch method.name {
				case "InsertCount", "UpdateCount":
					wantArgs = []database.Argument{database.StringArgument("text"), database.BoolArgument(true), database.BytesArgument([]byte("token")), database.Float64Argument(1.5), database.Int64Argument(7)}
				case "Clear":
					wantArgs = []database.Argument{}
				}
				if !reflect.DeepEqual(statement.Args, wantArgs) {
					t.Fatal("count parameter order lost")
				}
			}
			for _, malformed := range []database.Result{{}, {Statements: []database.StatementResult{{}, {}}}, {Statements: []database.StatementResult{{AffectedRows: 3, Rows: [][]database.Value{{database.Int64Argument(1)}}}}}} {
				backend.result = malformed
				count, err := method.call()
				assertZeroError(t, count, err, database.ErrBackend)
			}
			for _, cause := range []error{database.ErrConflict, database.ErrResultUnknown, context.Canceled, context.DeadlineExceeded} {
				backend.result = database.Result{Statements: []database.StatementResult{{AffectedRows: 3}}}
				backend.err = cause
				calls := backend.calls
				count, err := method.call()
				assertZeroError(t, count, err, cause)
				if err != cause || backend.calls != calls+1 {
					t.Fatal("backend error changed or count mutation retried")
				}
			}
		})
	}
	if provider, err := access.New(nil); provider != nil || err != database.ErrUnavailable {
		t.Fatal("nil dependency accepted")
	}
	var absent *access.Provider
	if count, err := absent.InsertCount(ctx, request); count != 0 || err != database.ErrUnavailable {
		t.Fatal("nil provider count did not fail safely")
	}
	if row, err := absent.DeleteOptional(ctx, contract.Filter{}); row != nil || err != database.ErrUnavailable {
		t.Fatal("nil provider RETURNING did not fail safely")
	}
}

func asRow(t *testing.T, value any) contract.Row {
	t.Helper()
	switch rows := value.(type) {
	case contract.Row:
		return rows
	case *contract.Row:
		if rows != nil {
			return *rows
		}
	case []contract.Row:
		if len(rows) == 1 {
			return rows[0]
		}
	}
	t.Fatal("expected one typed RETURNING row", value)
	return contract.Row{}
}

func assertZeroError(t *testing.T, output any, err, want error) {
	t.Helper()
	if !reflect.ValueOf(output).IsZero() || !errors.Is(err, want) {
		t.Fatalf("partial output or changed error: %#v, %v; want %v", output, err, want)
	}
}
